digraph daily_lens_publish {

    finalize_daily_lens [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="daily_lens.finalize" label="Finalize Daily Lens artifacts and publication" output_format="json" outputs="ok,scheduled_job_issue_url,scheduled_job_issue_number" action_repo="${repo}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_run_id="${__run_id}" timeout="10m" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_date="${date}" action_output_dir="${output_dir}" action_bundle_path="${bundle_path}" action_analysis_path="${analysis_output_path}" action_window_start="${window_start}" action_window_end="${window_end}" action_notify_slack="${notify_slack}" action_issue_labels_json="${issue_labels_json}" action_agent_result_json="${daily_lens_agent_result}" action_skip_followup_candidates="true" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]

    load_daily_lens_analysis_prompt [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Load Daily Lens analysis prompt" output_key="daily_lens_analysis_prompt" prompt="cat packages/factory-prompts/prompts/daily_lens/agent_analysis.md" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]

    set_date [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_default" label="Bind report date" output_key="date" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_value="${date}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]

    set_notify_slack [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_default" label="Bind Slack notify flag" output_key="notify_slack" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_value="${notify_slack}" action_fallback="false" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    set_output_dir [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_default" label="Bind output dir" output_key="output_dir" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_value="${output_dir}" action_fallback="reports/lens" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    set_repo [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_default" label="Bind report repo" output_key="repo" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_value="${repo}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    set_repo_path [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_default" label="Bind repo path" output_key="repo_path" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_value="${repo_path}" action_fallback="." trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    set_runs_dir [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_default" label="Bind runs dir" output_key="runs_dir" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_value="${runs_dir}" action_fallback=".hatch/runs" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    set_window_end [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_default" label="Bind window end" output_key="window_end" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_value="${window_end}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    set_window_start [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_default" label="Bind window start" output_key="window_start" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_value="${window_start}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    start [shape="Mdiamond" label="Start"]

}
